source.label: Kineticist Hoops rules and strategy tutorial

strategy.overview: Hoops builds Multiball through the top lanes and three saucers. Roll through the lit top lane, moving it with the flipper buttons before the ball arrives, then shoot a flashing lock shot; the left saucer is usually the cleanest choice. The first lock on a ball starts two-ball Multiball. Re-lock both balls in the saucers for Super Slam and take the million-point award unless your basket bonus is already unusually large.
strategy.simpleOverview: Move the lit top lane with the flipper buttons and roll through it to light lock, then shoot a flashing saucer; the left saucer is usually easiest. The first lock starts two-ball Multiball. Re-lock both balls in the saucers for Super Slam, then choose 1,000,000 points unless your basket bonus is already very large.
strategy.summary: Roll through the lit top lane to light lock, then shoot a flashing saucer; the first lock starts two-ball Multiball. Re-lock both balls for Super Slam and normally take 1,000,000 points. Repeat on the same ball for a two-lock, three-ball Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Light lock
quickInfo.summary: Roll through the lit top lane; move its light with the flipper buttons.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot any flashing lock shot; the left saucer is usually the cleanest.

quickInfo.name: Super Slam
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, re-lock every ball in the saucers.

quickInfo.name: Repeat Multiball
quickInfo.summary: On the same ball, light and lock two balls to start three-ball play.

steps.text: Use the flipper buttons to move the lit top lane, then roll through that lane to light lock.
Shoot a flashing lock shot; the left saucer is normally the most controllable choice. The first lock on the ball starts two-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, send both balls back into the saucers to collect Super Slam.
Choose 1,000,000 points instead of 20 baskets unless your current basket bonus is already large enough to justify the long game.
If the same ball continues, repeat the qualification and lock two balls; the next Multiball is three-ball, with a 3,000,000-or-50-basket Super Slam choice.

alternatives.title: Build Hang Time
alternatives.when: Use this while Multiball qualification is not ready or when the spinner is returning safely.

steps.text: Hit the blue Hang Time target near the top lanes to start the feature.
Build the value with spinner and bumper hits.
Roll through the right inlane, then hit the captive ball to collect the current Hang Time value without resetting it.

alternatives.title: Play Alley-Oop
alternatives.when: Use this when the captive-ball return is under control.

steps.text: Hit the captive ball to light the Fast Break loop.
Shoot the Fast Break loop, then make the right saucer before another non-bumper switch to collect ten baskets.
Complete the four SLAM DUNK standups and the return-lane requirements.
Each completed SLAM DUNK raises the basket multiplier by one for the rest of the ball, up to 3x.
Use the higher multiplier to make ordinary basket scoring matter; Super Slam's basket award itself is not multiplied.

machineSetup: Confirm whether extra ball and special award the feature or 500,000 points under tournament settings.
Test all three top lanes, the left, center, and right saucers, captive ball, spinner, Fast Break loop, and saucer kickouts before competitive play.

cautions.issue: Super Slam offers basket points as an alternative to direct points, but baskets usually need a long ball and a raised multiplier to overtake the million-point award.
cautions.response: Take the direct points by default; choose baskets only when the displayed basket bonus makes the conversion worthwhile.
